# CAMPANILE's model kit: every figure, weapon and hand, as parts on bones. render/kit.js reads it.
#   @ name                      a model
#   > bone parent x y z         a bone in its parent's space ('-' for the root)
#   b|c|s|k|n w h d  x y z  rx ry rz  colour     box, cylinder (w top, d bottom diameter), sphere, capsule, cone
# Forward is -z, up is +y, right is +x, metres, radians.
#
# A figure is posed by its bones hips, torso, head, armL/R, foreL/R, legL/R and shinL/R. An elbow hangs 0.3
# below its shoulder and a palm 0.3 below its elbow: render/actors.js reaches for the weapon with those lengths.
# The gun bone carries no parts; the weapon in hand is hung on it.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the armoury
# One model serves the hand in first person and the figure in the street. Bones the code knows:
#   grip, fore   where the right and the left palm rest          tip     the muzzle
#   mag > clip   where the left hand takes the magazine, measured from fore, and the magazine that leaves
#   act > thru   the part a shot works (bolt, slide, pump, the blade itself) and how far it travels
#   carry        where the model rides on a figure, measured from the figure's gun bone
